title: The Shortcodes Ultimate WordPress plugin before 7.9.1 does not prevent format specifiers in a shortcode attribute from…
description: The Shortcodes Ultimate WordPress plugin versions before 7.9.1 contain a vulnerability where format specifiers in shortcode attributes are not properly prevented from being interpreted during navigation menu markup generation. This flaw allows users with Contributor-level roles to execute stored cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks.
